Interface NetSerializerBuilder.ArrayStyle<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The data type within the array
Enclosing interface:
NetSerializerBuilder
public static interface NetSerializerBuilder.ArrayStyle<T>
Converts a serializer to a array type. Array types maybe prefixed with a number serializer to denote the size of the array, but isnt always true. This part of the builder specifies what prefix should be used (if any)
